goal: Keep improving the 3D island game so it runs smooth and feels like a real game. Each iteration, pick the single highest-impact improvement to the rendering, world or feel, make it, and keep the whole substrate green. Hard rules: never weaken, skip or delete a test to make the gate pass; never raise the draw-call/triangle budget in tests/perf.spec.js or loosen the thresholds in scripts/visual-gate.mjs; the game must keep working on the plain mobile render path (no post-processing on touch devices). Work in small, verifiable steps.
_note: Command gate only, on purpose. Per docs/GATES.md, taste cannot be machine-gated -- an LLM grading its own screenshots burns tokens and marks its own homework. So the gate proves the OBJECTIVE substrate: the build is clean, all 23 Playwright specs pass (e2e + perf budget + mobile), and scripts/visual-gate.mjs asserts pixel facts on a real gameplay frame for BOTH render paths (not blank, not blown out, tonal spread present, ground actually rendered, zero console errors). That gate was checked in both directions: it passes on the good build and fails on a deliberately blown-out one. Judging whether it looks PREMIUM is still a human call -- run with a human_gate for that.

command_gate.command: pnpm build && pnpm test && node scripts/visual-gate.mjs
